messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's current action to walking forward, following the movement demonstrated in the reference video. Retain the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's current action to walking forward, following the demonstration in the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"He stands still facing right, then begins walking slowly forward and to the right, swinging his arms naturally.","camera":"Full-body shot at a low angle; the camera pans right to follow the subject as he walks.","clothing":"White sleeveless tank top with a faded pink and yellow graphic, pink athletic shorts with white trim, and pink slip-on sneakers with white soles.","hair_color":"Dark, with only a small amount visible at the sides under the cap.","hairstyle":"Short hair, mostly covered by a white cap worn backward.","identity":"A slim, dark-skinned young man with a defined build, shown in full body.","scene":"An outdoor paved road or parking area beside a concrete overpass, with a metal guardrail, green trees, utility poles, and a bright blue sky with light clouds."},"uncertain":["The exact graphic/text on the tank top is too small and faded to read clearly."]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's dancing motion with a slow forward walk. The person's clothing, cap, body type, and general appearance remain consistent, and the outdoor overpass setting is retained. The camera appears to pan right to follow the walking subject, and new background elements such as an orange barrier appear as the viewpoint shifts.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action from dancing to walking forward, following the reference motion, while retaining identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression, and leaving the scene and camera unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the walking motion closely matches the reference video's cadence and arm movement.
Whether the person's facial expression was fully preserved.
unexpected_changes: The camera pans right to follow the subject instead of remaining unchanged.
The visible background changes as the subject walks, including the appearance of an orange barrier and different framing of the overpass and trees.
